title: A set operator on Null
question: Does AWS accept ForAllValues:Null, and what does it do? AWS doesn't say what a set operator does on Null. The analyzer refuses the policy.

cases.name: for_all_values_null_false
cases.description: ForAllValues:Null aws:TagKeys false, for a request that adds the tag campus.

readings.ALLOW: AWS accepts it, and the key is there
readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: AWS accepts it, and the condition doesn't hold
